note: Photographs of QR codes from open-source test collections assembled for other decoders. Only paths and SHA-256 hashes are committed, no third-party content: npm run fetch-photos downloads each image and its expected-text .txt file into vectors/photos-cache/ and checks both hashes, and the tests read the expected text from those files at run time. The text is UTF-8, compared exactly with no trimming and no newline normalisation. typescript and jsqr record which decoder read each photo when the baseline was taken (QR_WRITE_PHOTOS=1 regenerates them); ratchet.typescript is the floor the test enforces. Photographs whose greyscale pixels equal an earlier entry (re-encoded copies across sources) are left out. One photograph whose expected-text file differs from what its symbol says is left out too.
